title: Landscape Face Portrait
description: A close-up portrait of a person's face and upper neck seamlessly blended with a detailed green rolling hills landscape. The eyes and forehead show a painted sky with clouds and distant mountains, while the cheeks, nose and lips are covered in vibrant green fields. Golden Arabic calligraphy flows across the face and a twisted fleshy form with pink beads wraps around the neck and shoulders.
prompt: close-up surreal portrait of a person whose face is painted as a lush green rolling landscape with hills and fields, sky with clouds visible in the eye area, golden Arabic calligraphy flowing across the cheeks and nose, twisted fleshy textured neck with pink beads and organic forms, realistic skin texture blended with painted nature, dramatic lighting against dark background, highly detailed oil painting style
